text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just now, a journalist interviewing me
said she
admired how I "always live up to
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Many from my family also expect me to
achieve
our long-standing dream... To be
honest, I never
imagined I'd be running
under such pressure...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Which makes winning all the more
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to give everyone a chance to see
this
diamond shining in first place. ♪
